## Problem and result

Describe the user problem and what changes after this PR. Link related issues or discussions, if any.

## Validation

List the checks you actually ran, including OS/CPU when relevant. Live account checks are optional and consume quota; state explicitly if you did not run them.

## Review notes

Explain any compatibility changes, dependencies, storage changes, or remaining limitations. Include sanitized screenshots only when they help review a user-facing change.

- [ ] The change is focused and documentation matches the resulting behavior.
- [ ] Relevant checks passed, or failures/not-run checks are explained above.
- [ ] No credentials, login URLs, private prompts/images, or account state are included.
- [ ] Third-party notices are preserved where applicable.
